observation.command: cd /tmp && rm -f cj.txt && T=$(curl -s -c cj.txt http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in | grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -o /dev/null -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/users/sign_in --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$T" --data-urlencode "user[login]=verified@consul.dev" --data-urlencode "user[password]=Aa12345678"; curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt "http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals/new?origin=projekt&projekt_id=9&projekt_phase_id=3" -o f.html -w "form=%{http_code}\n"; FT=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' f.html | head -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//'); echo "form_token=${#FT}"; curl -s -b cj.txt -c cj.txt -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3000/proposals -o res.html -w "create=%{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$FT" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][locale]=de" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][title]=Validierungstest Vorschlag 2026" --data-urlencode "proposal[translations_attributes][0][description]=Dies ist eine ausreichend lange Beschreibung fuer den Validierungstest." --data-urlencode "proposal[projekt_phase_id]=3" --data-urlencode "proposal[resource_terms]=1" --data-urlencode "proposal[responsible_name]=Max Mustermann"
